email.subject: Studio 9 Works: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Marcus,

I checked Studio 9 Works' site. Two things are likely costing you clients: there's no booking link, so anyone wanting an appointment outside business hours has to remember to call back later (and many won't). And there's no click-to-call button on mobile, so people have to manually copy your number instead of tapping to dial.

I also noticed no reviews on the page and the footer has outdated info.

I'm Alex, I run Northlight Web, fixed-fee website fixes for local businesses. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough of what I'd change and why? No pitch, just the rundown.

Alex
